1|"""Provider registry — a plugin system for compute back-ends.
2|
3|Providers self-register via the ``@provider`` decorator or by
4|calling ``ProviderRegistry.register()``.  Selection is done by name
5|so that manifests can specify ``provider: docker``, ``provider: proxmox``,
6|etc. without the core knowing about specific implementations.
7|"""
8|
9|import logging
10|from typing import Dict, Optional, Type
11|
12|from .base import ComputeProvider
13|
14|logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
15|
16|
17|class ProviderRegistry:
18|    """Global registry of available compute providers."""
19|
20|    _providers: Dict[str, Type[ComputeProvider]] = {}
21|    _instances: Dict[str, ComputeProvider] = {}
22|
23|    @classmethod
24|    def register(cls, provider_cls: Type[ComputeProvider]) -> Type[ComputeProvider]:
25|        """Register a provider class (also usable as a decorator)."""
26|        name = getattr(provider_cls, "name", None)
27|        if name is None:
28|            try:
29|                name = provider_cls().name
30|            except Exception:
31|                name = provider_cls.__name__.lower()
32|        if name in cls._providers:
33|            logger.warning("Overwriting existing provider: %s", name)
34|        cls._providers[name] = provider_cls
35|        logger.info("Registered compute provider: %s (%s)", name, provider_cls.__name__)
36|        return provider_cls
37|
38|    @classmethod
39|    def get(cls, name: str, **kwargs) -> Optional[ComputeProvider]:
40|        """Return a singleton provider instance by name."""
41|        if name in cls._instances:
42|            return cls._instances[name]
43|        provider_cls = cls._providers.get(name)
44|        if not provider_cls:
45|            logger.error(
46|                "Unknown compute provider: %s (available: %s)",
47|                name,
48|                list(cls._providers),
49|            )
50|            return None
51|        try:
52|            instance = provider_cls(**kwargs)
53|            cls._instances[name] = instance
54|            return instance
55|        except Exception as exc:
56|            logger.error("Failed to instantiate provider %s: %s", name, exc)
57|            return None
58|
59|    @classmethod
60|    def list_providers(cls) -> Dict[str, str]:
61|        """Return ``{name: qualname}`` for every registered provider."""
62|        return {
63|            n: f"{c.__module__}.{c.__qualname__}" for n, c in cls._providers.items()
64|        }
65|
66|    @classmethod
67|    def clear(cls) -> None:
68|        """Reset registry (useful in tests)."""
69|        cls._providers.clear()
70|        cls._instances.clear()
